verses.text: The Lord replied, “Is it right for you to be angry?”
verses.title: God’s Compassion

verses.text: The Lord confides in those who fear him; he makes his covenant known to them. My eyes are ever on the Lord , for only he will release my feet from the snare.
And we know that in all things God works for the good of those who love him, who have been called according to his purpose.
